known_limitations: Customer data remains user scoped until the explicit organization and business ownership migration assigned to Phase 202.
Tutorial and Academy progress remains user-local browser state and is not portable server-side customer state.
The legacy multipurpose 3D renderer remains an embedded drawing-engine migration boundary behind canonical projection and shared view state.
Mobile Universe Graph refinement remains explicit Phase 200 UX debt; Phase 199 does not implement that future-phase work.
Administrative step-up temporarily uses the static production ADMIN_MFA_CODE control rather than per-user dynamic MFA.
Checkout remains fail-closed and unavailable until separately authorized provider, pricing, legal, and launch gates pass.
